articles.title: 'Bada bhai will be CM': Amit Shah after BJP-SAD announce alliance in Punjab
articles.description: Bharatiya Janata Party and Shiromani Akali Dal have announced their alliance for the upcoming 2027 assembly elections. The two parties aim to jointly contest all 117 seats with Akali Dal in the lead. Union home minister Amit Shah emphasised key priorities in their campaign, including tackling drugs and corruption. A detailed manifesto highlighting these issues will be prepared soon by both parties.

articles.title: An Australian woman's Doberman fell nearly six metres into an abandoned mineshaft
articles.description: In a remarkable rescue in Western Victoria, a Doberman named Magic plummeted nearly six metres into an abandoned mineshaft while pursuing a rabbit. Thankfully, the Fire Rescue Victoria's high-angle rescue team managed to pull her out unharmed. This isn't the first time for her owner, as another of their dogs had a similar mishap years ago. The area is home to many disused mineshafts, which can be dangerous.

articles.title: LA landlord accused of fake ICE scare targeting Latino tenants, ordered to pay $7.65 million
articles.description: Andrew and Brigid Elrod won $7.65 million after a Los Angeles jury found their Koreatown landlord, K3 Holdings, had harassed and retaliated against them for organising tenants. A former company manager testified that its principal suggested using fake ICE uniforms to frighten Latino residents into leaving. The couple moved out in 2023 after repeated eviction threats.

articles.title: LeT, JeM proxies exposed, ISI eyes revival of 19 dormant terror outfits in J&K
articles.description: Pakistan's ISI is reportedly planning to revive 19 dormant terror outfits in Jammu and Kashmir as security agencies expose links between existing proxy groups and Pakistan-based organisations Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammed. The strategy could involve reconnecting with former militants, recruiting local youth and rebuilding networks to evade investigations. The revived outfits may also be used for propaganda and disinformation campaigns.

articles.title: PSU statutory audits: ICAI and CAG discuss cybersecurity, financial reporting and audit standards
articles.description: ICAI organised a national workshop in New Delhi to examine statutory audit quality, transparency and accountability in public sector undertakings. Around 550 participants attended the event, which included two panel discussions and two technical sessions. Discussions covered digital auditing, cybersecurity, data governance, financial reporting and CAG directions. Participants also examined the responsibilities of statutory auditors in Central and State PSUs, along with practical challenges in audit procedures and regulatory compliance.

articles.title: CMAT 2027 Registration Begins: Apply by December 20, exam scheduled for February 11; check direct link here
articles.description: CMAT 2027 registration: The National Testing Agency has started CMAT 2027 registration from November 23, 2026, for admission to management programmes in the 2027-28 academic session. Candidates can apply online until December 20, while the late application window will remain open from December 22 to 25 with an additional fee of Rs 500. The computer-based examination is scheduled for February 11, 2027. Admit cards will be released on February 4 through the official CMAT website.

articles.title: SSC CHSL City Intimation Slip 2026 released at ssc.gov.in, check exam city and download steps
articles.description: SSC CHSL City Intimation Slip 2026: The Staff Selection Commission has released the SSC CHSL Tier 1 City Intimation Slip 2026 on its official website, ssc.gov.in. Registered candidates can log in using their registration number, password and captcha code to check their allotted examination city. The Tier 1 examination will be conducted from December 3 to December 31, 2026. Admit cards are expected two to three days before the respective examination dates and must be downloaded separately.

articles.title: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026: Vacancies increased to 13,152, applications begin November 26
articles.description: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has increased LRD vacancies to 12,752 and announced 241 additional PSI cadre posts, taking total recruitment vacancies to 13,152. Applications will open on November 26, 2026, at 2 PM and close on December 16 at 11:59 PM. Class 12 qualifications are required for constable posts, while PSI applicants need a bachelor's degree. Applications must be submitted online through the OJAS portal.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' box office collection day 20 (LIVE)
articles.description: The cinematic masterpiece 'Ramayana: Part 1' by Nitesh Tiwari continues to captivate audiences over three weeks post-launch, amassing Rs 955.45 crore net in India alone. With a total domestic revenue of Rs 1,141.65 crore and Rs 91.70 crore net during Days 16 to 19, the film has claimed the fifth spot among India's all-time blockbusters. Surpassing previous records, its worldwide earnings have soared to Rs 1,437.

articles.title: 'O.M' BO Day 5 [Live]: Dhanush's film slows down on weekdays
articles.description: Dhanush's film 'O.M: Operation Mole' opened strongly but faced a decline in box office collections during weekdays. After earning Rs 18.10 crore on its first day, the film's collections dropped significantly on Monday. By Tuesday, the film had accumulated Rs 57.48 crore in net collections across India. The Tamil version led the day's earnings, followed by Telugu and Hindi versions. These figures will likely change as more data becomes available.
